2. In the present quashing application, the petitioners have challenged the order dated 24.02.2009 passed by the learned S.D.J.M., Katihar framing charge against them under Sections 16(1) and 16(a)(i) under the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1957 in Criminal Proceeding B-III Case No.

3.

entities.text:
Criminal Proceeding B-III Case No.
5 of 2001
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: Learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioners submits that only allegation against the petitioners is that they were engaged in selling sealed misbranded mustered oil under the label and wrapper of New Kishan Mustard Oil.
He further submits that sample of seized mustered oil was sent to the Public Analyst for analysis and the report indicates no adulteration was found in the oil.
Moreover in Patna High Court Cr.Misc. No.9217 of 2012 dt.03-07-2017 case of misbranding, the liability is not of the seller rather it is of the manufacturer.

He further submits that on the same day,
another prosecution case was launched against the petitioners with regard to seizure of misbranded pouch of Gutaka bearing Criminal Proceeding of B-III Case No. 03 of 2001 but the charge framed in the aforesaid case too was also set aside by a co-ordinate bench of this Court vide order dated 08.08.2012 passed in Cr. Misc. No. 1403 of 2012 holding therein that in case of misbranding the criminal liability is on the manufacturer and not on the shopkeeper.

entities.text: Suresh Sah @ Suresh Lal Sah & Anr vs The State Of Bihar
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Being the admitted position that the petitioners were shopkeepers and not manufacturers and in case of misbranding of a sealed product and being sold in the same state, as purchased by a shopkeeper, the responsibility lies with the manufacturer and not of the vendor, so the charge dated 24.02.2009 framed against the petitioners by the learned S.D.J.M., Katihar and subsequent criminal proceeding against them is hereby set aside.
In the result, this petition stands allowed.

(Arun Kumar, J) Sujit/-
